## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive (Energy only). Confirmations: overall sector breadth ≤4/11 and Financials (-4.95%) and Industrials (-3.55%) both negative; Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 concentrated in Energy/Materials; 3/5 Energy). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: OXY (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +26.84%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +9.13%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Energy: 8/10 positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Financials lag worst: TFC (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -18.66%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -19.01%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -14.69%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Financials: 2/20 positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DOW (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +13.17%) ABOVE TREND; OXY (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +26.84%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND; APD (1W: +5.11% | 1M: -0.10%) RECOVERY; PSX (1W: +4.60% | 1M: +11.58%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: BKNG (1W: -8.37% | 1M: -1.26%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -8.39% | 1M: -18.60%) BELOW TREND; TFC (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -18.66%) BELOW TREND; COF (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -19.01%) BELOW TREND; SYK (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Financials and select Services names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W: DOW (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +13.17%) ABOVE TREND; OXY (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +26.84%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged: GOOGL (1W: +0.96% | 1M: -4.65%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +2.82% | 1M: -0.46%) RECOVERY, AMZN (1W: -4.30% | 1M: +1.24%) CORRECTION — ≥3 large-name divergences, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is weak and internally mixed with several recoveries but many names BELOW TREND: PANW (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +1.58%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +2.82% | 1M: -0.46%) RECOVERY; ACN (1W: -8.39% | 1M: -18.60%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -1.74% | 1M: -6.55%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -0.10% | 1M: -2.86%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Tech: 4/24 positive.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials showing broad weakness with multiple majors BELOW TREND: JPM (1W: -3.63% | 1M: -11.12%) BELOW TREND; V (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -6.60%) BELOW TREND; MA (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -7.97%) BELOW TREND; COF (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -19.01%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Financials: 2/20 positive; downside risk remains.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak with a few defensive pockets: JNJ (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +2.09%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: -3.31% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION; LLY (1W: -0.61% | 1M: -4.50%) BELOW TREND; SYK (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare: 3/17 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select Materials exposure (OXY (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +26.84%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +9.13%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +13.17%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to vulnerable Financials and cyclical tech names showing confirmed BELOW TREND. With narrow leadership and major divergences among large-cap growth names, stay selective and monitor follow-through.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: DOW (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +13.17%) ABOVE TREND; OXY (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +26.84%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +1.58%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ACN (1W: -8.39% | 1M: -18.60%) BELOW TREND; COF (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -19.01%) BELOW TREND; AMZN (1W: -4.30% | 1M: +1.24%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Sector breadth: Energy: 8/10 positive) for continuation; Materials for idiosyncratic strength (DOW ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Financials (Financials: 2/20 positive) and Consumer Discretionary where booking and travel names remain weak.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -0.10% | 1M: -2.86%) BELOW TREND for a sustained 1W and 1M lift to confirm recovery; OXY (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +26.84%) ABOVE TREND for continuation above recent highs; AMZN (1W: -4.30% | 1M: +1.24%) CORRECTION — a clean 1W reversal would signal easing of the divergence.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
DOW (+55): DOW (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +13.17%) ABOVE TREND — Citi TP hike; price confirming sentiment. PANW (+60): PANW (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +1.58%) ABOVE TREND — deal and buyback news confirming the rally.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ACN (-55): ACN (1W: -8.39% | 1M: -18.60%) BELOW TREND — downgrade and negative sentiment confirming price weakness. COF (-45): COF (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -19.01%) BELOW TREND — sentiment matches heavy selling. AMZN (-50): AMZN (1W: -4.30% | 1M: +1.24%) CORRECTION — tax/legal headlines adding pressure and creating divergence vs 1M.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Value/Cyclical style. Energy and select Materials showing relative strength (OXY ABOVE TREND, DOW ABOVE TREND, CVX ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major 1W vs 1M divergences among large-cap tech (GOOGL RECOVERY, ORCL RECOVERY, AMZN CORRECTION) and concentrated leadership — watch for trend breaks and sentiment-driven distribution.
